meta.purpose_en: Each sentence is fully parsed: every word gets its class, case, sign, position (mahall) and classical i'rab phrase; the sentence gets its type, purpose, overall place (mahall) and a tarkeeb paragraph. words[].mahall references positions.json ids; structure roles describe the whole-sentence tree. 'tok' groups split parts of one written token (e.g. بِالقلمِ = بِ + القلمِ).

word_fields.tok: written-token number (optional; required when one token is split into several units)
word_fields.kind: subtype: zahir, sifa, zarf, ishara, mawsul, istifham, munada, damir / madi, mudari, amr, madi_naqis / harf_jarr, nawasikh_inna, ...
word_fields.case: raf | nasb | jarr | jazm | null (mabni words have no case)
word_fields.mahall: position id from positions.json (null if none)
